real difference to our customers and markets, and the chance to be part of an international and
inclusive community of great people. 

Join us for opportunities to build a varied career, in a company that's building for the future.

inclusive community of great people. 

Join us for opportunities to build a varied career, in a company that's building for the future.

# Finding Clarity in Chaos

Spend More Time Acting on Competitive Intelligence and Less Time Searching for It

## Who We Serve

##### Executives

Personalized executive briefings deliver strategic insights on:
* Growth Opportunities
* Target Acquisitions
* Financial Reports
* Potential Partners
* Market Innovations

[Learn More »][25] 

##### Product Teams

Product teams save time and money by receiving real-time insights on: 
* Competitor R&D Plans
* Product Roadmaps
* Customer Insights
* Pricing Models
* Market Trends

[Learn More »][26]

##### Intelligence Teams

We help CI teams deliver better intelligence in less time by providing: 
* A custom research portal
* Curated intelligence feeds
* An assigned analyst
* Personalized email briefings
* Ad hoc research support

[Learn More »][27]

##### Marketing Teams

Stay one step ahead of competitors by using our marketing intelligence for: 
* Competitor benchmarking
* Campaign vulnerabilities
* Competitor tactics
* New lead sources
* Content strategy

[Learn More »][28]

[Email Briefings Infographic]

### Customized Email Briefings for Every Stakeholder

We combine smart technology with human curation and analysis to make our email briefings not only
accurate, but also filled with hard-to-find, unpublicized information. This process makes our
briefings concise, targeted and easy to scan because we only push out notifications with critical
information - no nonsense.

Subscribers can customize the companies, topics, categories and products or services that matter
most to them

An assigned analyst who proactively uncovers new competitive threads, innovation trends and emerging
market disruptions

Only the most relevant and critical insights are delivered in each briefing

[Research Portal]

### Research Portal for Ad Hoc Analysis

All of the information we curate and deliver to you in email briefings is tagged and archived in a
custom research portal, which is maintained for you by your assigned analyst. Using this portal, you
can easily search and extract content using more than 100 different categories and filters.

Access not only publicized content, but unpublicized information like competitor sales
presentations, RFPs, pricing sheets and product plans

Built-in collaboration and distribution tools out of the box to add your own commentary and
insights.

Utilize playbooks to easily share insights with colleagues and stakeholders

[Analyst Process]

### Daily Curation by an Assigned Analyst

Our goal is to help you spend more time acting on intelligence and less time searching for it, which
is why we provide every client with an assigned analyst who curates information for you. Other
vendors may claim that they provide an "analyst," but in reality they only provide general customer
support or a help desk.

Your analyst proactively reaches out to discuss changes in your competitive environment and
recommend new companies or topics to track based on what they're seeing.

Contact by phone or email for any questions

Available for ad hoc research requests

## How We're Different in 90 Seconds

#### "Chris, our assigned CI Radar analyst, provides a daily summarized briefing of everything we
#### need to read each morning, without wasting our time on junk or irrelevant items. And the
#### briefings contain items we just can't find ourselves."

Managing Director, Computer Manufacturer

market disruptions

custom research portal, which is maintained for you by your assigned analyst. Using this portal, you
can easily search and extract content using more than 100 different categories and filters.

Access not only publicized content, but unpublicized information like competitor sales
presentations, RFPs, pricing sheets and product plans

Built-in collaboration and distribution tools out of the box to add your own commentary and
insights.

Utilize playbooks to easily share insights with colleagues and stakeholders

[Analyst Process]

### Daily Curation by an Assigned Analyst

Our goal is to help you spend more time acting on intelligence and less time searching for it, which
is why we provide every client with an assigned analyst who curates information for you. Other
vendors may claim that they provide an "analyst," but in reality they only provide general customer
support or a help desk.

Your analyst proactively reaches out to discuss changes in your competitive environment and
recommend new companies or topics to track based on what they're seeing.

Contact by phone or email for any questions

Available for ad hoc research requests

## Search, enrich, and download B2B data with a simple prompt

Describe the B2B data you need for lead enrichment, product development, or market research. Our AI
agent generates a structured list you can review, enrich, and download in seconds.

[
Start now free
][92]

### 1. Write a prompt and generate your list

Start with a simple prompt, get a list of matching records, and refine your search query in chat.

### 2. Enrich your list

Select additional data fields and update you list with new information.

### 3. Download the data

Export up to 100 records for preview, or generate an enriched JSONL with up to 10,000 multi-source
records.

## Dedicated solutions for agentic search

AI agents need data infrastructure built for how they actually work. Explore Coresignal's agentic
search solutions - designed for agent loops, automated pipelines,
and chat like research interfaces at scale.

### Agentic Search API

Query structured B2B data using natural language prompts. Choose between a Fast endpoint for
high-volume automated workflows and a Reasoning endpoint for complex, multi-condition searches.

workflows. Give AI systems direct access to structured B2B context without building custom
integrations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Straight answers about how we review, how we stay independent, and how to get the most from

Is DroidCrunch independent and unbiased?

Yes. We trial or buy tools ourselves and put them to work on live projects before we review them.

flaws and dealbreakers.

How does DroidCrunch make money?

Some links on our site are affiliate links that earn us a small commission at no extra cost to you.
This never changes our rating or whether we recommend a tool. If something is not worth it, we say
so plainly.

Do you actually test every tool you review?

We test on real projects wherever possible, using the features that actually matter day to day. When
a section is based on documentation or pricing rather than hands-on use, we tell you clearly so you
always know what is behind a claim.

How often is your content updated?

## Frequently Asked Questions

Straight answers about how we review, how we stay independent, and how to get the most from
DroidCrunch.

Is DroidCrunch independent and unbiased?

Yes. We trial or buy tools ourselves and put them to work on live projects before we review them.
Our verdicts are based on real performance and value, never on who pays us, and we openly point out
flaws and dealbreakers.

How does DroidCrunch make money?

Some links on our site are affiliate links that earn us a small commission at no extra cost to you.
This never changes our rating or whether we recommend a tool. If something is not worth it, we say
so plainly.

Do you actually test every tool you review?

We test on real projects wherever possible, using the features that actually matter day to day. When
a section is based on documentation or pricing rather than hands-on use, we tell you clearly so you
always know what is behind a claim.

How often is your content updated?

We revisit reviews and guides as tools change their pricing, features and policies, so the advice
stays accurate. Every article shows a published or last-updated date so you can see how current it
is.

Who writes DroidCrunch reviews?

Reviews come from founder Lokesh Kapoor and the DroidCrunch team, drawing on hands-on experience
with WordPress, SEO, SaaS and creator tools since 2016. We write for both beginners and pros, in
plain English.

What topics does DroidCrunch cover?

We cover WordPress, SEO, hosting, VPNs, proxies, AI tools, automation, no-code platforms and other
business software for bloggers, marketers, agencies and creators looking to build and grow online.

Can I trust your best-of recommendations?

Yes. We curate hard, drop weak or irrelevant options, and explain who each tool is best for and who

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Is the free plan really free? No credit card?
Yes, completely free. You can create a profile, start posting (up to 20 posts), and appear in the
community feed without entering any payment information. You only pay when you upgrade to a Growth
or Scale plan.
How does the automatic website work?
When you upgrade to a paid plan, Easyfie generates a professional website using your existing posts
and profile. You choose a template, connect your domain, and your content is automatically organised
and published. New posts also appear on your website instantly.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes. Growth and Scale plans include custom domain support. You can connect your existing domain or
we can help you set one up. Hosting is fully managed and included — no extra fees.
What types of businesses is Easyfie best for?
Easyfie works for any local or online business — retail shops, salons, freelancers, photographers,
consultants, restaurants, and more. If you sell products, offer services, or want to build a
following, Easyfie is built for you.
Can I cancel my plan at any time?
Yes, there are no long-term contracts. Cancel any time and your account reverts to the free plan at
the end of your billing cycle. Your posts and profile data are always kept safe.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Is the free plan really free? No credit card?
Yes, completely free. You can create a profile, start posting (up to 20 posts), and appear in the
community feed without entering any payment information. You only pay when you upgrade to a Growth
or Scale plan.
How does the automatic website work?
When you upgrade to a paid plan, Easyfie generates a professional website using your existing posts
and profile. You choose a template, connect your domain, and your content is automatically organised
and published. New posts also appear on your website instantly.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes. Growth and Scale plans include custom domain support. You can connect your existing domain or
we can help you set one up. Hosting is fully managed and included — no extra fees.
What types of businesses is Easyfie best for?
Easyfie works for any local or online business — retail shops, salons, freelancers, photographers,
consultants, restaurants, and more. If you sell products, offer services, or want to build a
following, Easyfie is built for you.
Can I cancel my plan at any time?
Yes, there are no long-term contracts. Cancel any time and your account reverts to the free plan at
the end of your billing cycle. Your posts and profile data are always kept safe.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do credits work across different API?

We use a unified credit system. Simple requests like DNS Lookup, TLS Scan, Scraping cost **1
credit**. Advanced requests like Screenshotting, or PDF generation cost **5 credits**. You have one
pool of credits for all our APIs. Read more about [how credit works][28].

Does the Scraping API handle JavaScript & SPAs?

Yes, you can add `renderJS: true` in request payload to render JavaScript.

What happens after I use my free credits?

The free tier renews every month. If you need more, you can upgrade to a paid plan starting at
**$19/mo.**

How many concurrent requests can I send?

The Free plan allows **1** concurrent request. The Growth plan allows **10**, and the Business plan
allows **25**. If you need enterprise-grade concurrency (**1000+**), please contact us.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do credits work across different API?

We use a unified credit system. Simple requests like DNS Lookup, TLS Scan, Scraping cost **1
credit**. Advanced requests like Screenshotting, or PDF generation cost **5 credits**. You have one
pool of credits for all our APIs. Read more about [how credit works][28].

Does the Scraping API handle JavaScript & SPAs?

Yes, you can add `renderJS: true` in request payload to render JavaScript.

What happens after I use my free credits?

The free tier renews every month. If you need more, you can upgrade to a paid plan starting at
**$19/mo.**

How many concurrent requests can I send?

The Free plan allows **1** concurrent request. The Growth plan allows **10**, and the Business plan
allows **25**. If you need enterprise-grade concurrency (**1000+**), please contact us.

# Gain Actionable Global Trade Insights with Global Trade Tracker

## Global Trade Tracker: the most powerful suite of trade data analysis tools on the planet.

Global Trade Tracker: built for commodity trade analysts – made in Switzerland.

## Why use Global Trade Tracker?

For [competitive intelligence][36] or [market research][37]; for [predictive modelling][38] or
[evaluating new markets][39], the Global Trade Tracker suite of tools puts you in charge.

One data repository. Five interfaces. Within just hours of receipt, data is already available for
searching on GTT. This means that you will be the first to know.

## Your Subscription – Your Choice

GTT offers you a wide range of different pricing models, from pay-per-report transactional, through
to all-you-can-eat subscription, as well as a selection of hybrid models.

Subscribe to the commodities and countries that you use most, and still have access to all other
commodities and countries on a pay-as-you-go basis. We will match you with the model that offers
best value for your research needs.

[ READ ON... ][40]

## The Harmonized System for Commodity Coding

By using the harmonized system classification coding covering thousands of unique products and
commodities, the Global Trade Tracker toolset tells you what’s really happening in your markets. GTT

Gagnez du temps en faisant appel à nos experts en intelligence d'affaires pour mieux comprendre
votre marché, rester à l’affût des occasions et des tendances et accéder à des données fiables et de
qualité.

[Lancement d'entreprise][43]

Vous songez à démarrer votre propre entreprise, à acheter une entreprise existante ou à prendre la
relève de l'entreprise familiale? Notre équipe de conseillers vous offre un accompagnement
personnalisé pour vous aider à réaliser votre projet.

## NOS SERVICES

[Conseils et orientation][44]

**Grâce à un diagnostic de votre projet et de vos ambitions et à des conseils personnalisés
gratuits**, nos conseillers vous dirigeront vers les meilleures ressources, solutions et sources de
financement pour propulser votre projet, et ce, en fonction de vos objectifs d'affaires.

[Plus d’infos ][45]

[Intelligence d'affaires][46]

Nos experts en intelligence d'affaires exploitent des milliers de données pour produire une
information fiable, gratuite ou à un coût avantageux, à partir de laquelle vous pouvez agir.

[Plus d’infos ][47]

[Conseils d'affaires ][48]

Nous vous mettons en contact avec des conseillers en affaires expérimentés qui sauront vous guider
sur différents aspects de votre projet, et ce, à des prix très concurrentiels.

[Plus d’infos ][49]

[Certification à l'exportation ][50]

Nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers qui souhaitent mener des activités d’exportation à
certifier leurs documents rapidement et à faible coût.

[Plus d’infos ][51]

## RESSOURCES EN LIGNE

Accédez à plus de [2 000 ressources en ligne][52] et à des outils pratiques et gratuits pour
orienter vos démarches et vous permettre de passer à la prochaine étape de votre projet avec succès.

## PRODUITS VEDETTES

[Répertoires d’organismes régionaux][53]

Trouvez les organismes pouvant soutenir votre projet d’affaires où que vous soyez au Québec.

[Financement ][54]

Découvrez les sources de financement disponibles selon votre projet d’affaires.

[Programmes de soutien et services][55]

Accédez aux programmes de soutien et services dont vous disposez pour réussir votre projet.

[Accélérateurs et incubateurs][56]

Découvrez les incubateurs et les accélérateurs pouvant contribuer à la réussite de votre projet de
lancement ou de croissance d’entreprise.

[Concours et bourses][57]

Participez à des concours pour financer et promouvoir votre projet, rencontrer des experts et
réseauter.

[Formations en démarrage][58]

Choisissez le parcours de formation convenant le mieux à votre projet.

[Vendre aux gouvernements][59]

Obtenez des renseignements sur les occasions d’affaires et les procédures de soumission aux marchés
publics.

[Répertoires spécialisés][60]

Consultez ces répertoires de ressources destinées à des clientèles spécifiques et à la mise en œuvre
de modèles d’affaires de transition.

[Événements et occasions d’affaires][61]

Voyez les appels de candidatures, les missions commerciales, les concours et les événements offerts
partout dans la province.

L'obtention de financement peut s'avérer l’une des étapes les plus difficiles pour un entrepreneur.
Nos experts sont là pour vous aider.

[Données de marché et statistiques][42]

Gagnez du temps en faisant appel à nos experts en intelligence d'affaires pour mieux comprendre
votre marché, rester à l’affût des occasions et des tendances et accéder à des données fiables et de
qualité.

[Lancement d'entreprise][43]

Vous songez à démarrer votre propre entreprise, à acheter une entreprise existante ou à prendre la
relève de l'entreprise familiale? Notre équipe de conseillers vous offre un accompagnement
personnalisé pour vous aider à réaliser votre projet.

## NOS SERVICES

[Conseils et orientation][44]

**Grâce à un diagnostic de votre projet et de vos ambitions et à des conseils personnalisés
gratuits**, nos conseillers vous dirigeront vers les meilleures ressources, solutions et sources de
financement pour propulser votre projet, et ce, en fonction de vos objectifs d'affaires.

[Plus d’infos ][45]

[Intelligence d'affaires][46]

Nos experts en intelligence d'affaires exploitent des milliers de données pour produire une
information fiable, gratuite ou à un coût avantageux, à partir de laquelle vous pouvez agir.

[Plus d’infos ][47]

[Conseils d'affaires ][48]

Nous vous mettons en contact avec des conseillers en affaires expérimentés qui sauront vous guider
sur différents aspects de votre projet, et ce, à des prix très concurrentiels.

[Plus d’infos ][49]

[Certification à l'exportation ][50]

Nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers qui souhaitent mener des activités d’exportation à
certifier leurs documents rapidement et à faible coût.

[Plus d’infos ][51]

## RESSOURCES EN LIGNE

Accédez à plus de [2 000 ressources en ligne][52] et à des outils pratiques et gratuits pour
orienter vos démarches et vous permettre de passer à la prochaine étape de votre projet avec succès.

## PRODUITS VEDETTES

[Répertoires d’organismes régionaux][53]

Trouvez les organismes pouvant soutenir votre projet d’affaires où que vous soyez au Québec.

[Financement ][54]

Découvrez les sources de financement disponibles selon votre projet d’affaires.

[Programmes de soutien et services][55]

Accédez aux programmes de soutien et services dont vous disposez pour réussir votre projet.

[Accélérateurs et incubateurs][56]

Découvrez les incubateurs et les accélérateurs pouvant contribuer à la réussite de votre projet de
lancement ou de croissance d’entreprise.

[Concours et bourses][57]

Participez à des concours pour financer et promouvoir votre projet, rencontrer des experts et
réseauter.

[Formations en démarrage][58]

Choisissez le parcours de formation convenant le mieux à votre projet.

[Vendre aux gouvernements][59]

Obtenez des renseignements sur les occasions d’affaires et les procédures de soumission aux marchés
publics.

[Répertoires spécialisés][60]

Consultez ces répertoires de ressources destinées à des clientèles spécifiques et à la mise en œuvre
de modèles d’affaires de transition.

[Événements et occasions d’affaires][61]

Voyez les appels de candidatures, les missions commerciales, les concours et les événements offerts
partout dans la province.

## Deliver more value. Show you're the expert. Make sales smoother.

Selling digital services that business owners understand and value has always been a frustrating,
time-consuming process. Until now! Our wide variety of site, store, and marketing audits gets
business owners to sit up and pay attention—with personalized recommendations that show you
understand their goals, not just their tech. Go from "Yawn, another sales pitch" to "We want to work
with you!" in less time than it takes to pick up fast food.

### Audit sites with AI in minutes

Stop wasting hours on countless tools, only to produce ugly, unreadable results. In just a few
minutes, you can run one of 10 in-depth audits. Easily produce beautiful reports that make
insightful recommendations on everything that matters.

[Audit sites with AI in minutes]

### Give more value than competitors

Move beyond "I don't need a website" or "We'll handle it in-house" with dozens of data points that
look at a client's entire online presence. Show them what they need to succeed—not just what they
think they want—then tell them exactly how you can do it.

[Give more value than competitors]

### Close bigger deals—faster and easier.

Build trust in your sales process by demonstrating what we call "extreme value,"" then leverage that
trust to secure larger projects that help your customers more. Stop selling "just" websites—start
selling answers to their most pressing marketing challenges.

[Close bigger deals faster]

## Our website, SEO, e-commerce, and other audit reports have
## helped agencies like yours sell millions
## of dollars worth of services

Use our audit tools to create professionally written and designed audit reports that
will help your agency sell faster and close more deals.

### Our most in-demand audit tools

#### AI website audit tool

Analyze your client's site with AI and deliver more than 100 actionable recommendations on how to
make their business better.

Our AI does more than scan for broken links and slow load times. It analyzes your lead's business,
looks at best practices in their industry, and reviews user experience patterns to deliver stunning
insights that will make an incredible difference.

Perfect for cold outreach, sales meetings where you want to show value immediately, or client
onboarding that sets you apart as the agency that "gets it."

[ View a sample website audit report ][38]
[AI website audit tool]
[ai-landing-page-audit]

#### AI landing page audit tool

Use the power of AI to offer actionable insights on how to convert more clicks into customers, even
if you don't know the first thing about conversions.

We've analyzed hundreds of high-converting landing pages and used that knowledge to train our AI.
With one click, evaluate everything from headline psychology to form placement. Our system
understands conversion principles that marketers take years to learn and applies them instantly to
any of your client's landing pages.

Use to audit client landing pages and present data-driven recommendations, not "best practice"
guesswork.

[ View a sample landing page audit report ][39]

#### Google Business Profile (GBP)
#### audit tool

Show businesses exactly what to optimize on their GBP profile to boost their local ranking on
Google, and help them get more visibility, calls, traffic, and leads.

This audit measures every element of a Google Business Profile against known ranking factors and
local search best practices. We’ve reverse-engineered what makes profiles rank in the top 3 results
and turned that into automated recommendations you can make easily.

Show businesses how they stack up against their competitors, and then sell them local SEO services
they didn't know they needed.

[ View a sample GBP audit report ][40]
[Google Business Profile (GBP) audit tool]

#### On-page SEO audit tool

Get dozens of actionable on-page SEO insights to help a web page rank higher on Google, and show
clients and leads you know what it takes to get found.

If you've worked with SEO, you know that on-page success is about search intent, user experience,
technical performance, and more. Our audit checks from keyword usage to page speed and Core Web
Vitals, giving you insights that used to take hours to compile.

Perfect for pitching SEO services to cold leads, auditing new clients during onboarding, or showing
your optimization expertise in sales calls.

[ View a sample on-page SEO report ][41]
[On-page SEO audit tool]

#### E-commerce website audit tool

Give businesses 100+ actionable insights to boost e-commerce website conversions by 25% or more, and
shave hours off your store audit process.

Improving an e-commerce website comes from understanding customer psychology, sales funnels, and
platform-specific best practices. This report shows businesses what drives purchases at every stage
of the customer journey.

Use the e-commerce website audit to show ROI-focused expertise with online stores at any stage of
your sales process.

[ View a sample E-Commerce audit report ][42]
[E-commerce website audit tool]

See all 10 audit reports you can deliver with My Web Audit

[ View all reports ][43]

## Why My Web Audit?

Here are just a few of the features that make My Web Audit the premier all-in-one website audit tool
for digital agencies, freelancers, and consultants. Created by agencies, for agencies, MWA tools
generate customized recommendations that address clients' unique business goals.

[Supercharged with AI]

### Supercharged with AI

Our most popular audit reports have been completely retooled to leverage the power of AI to create
easy-to-produce reports that feel fully custom. (More AI audits coming soon.)

[Beautiful and actionable]

### Beautiful and actionable

Create easy-to-understand audit reports in minutes, often with a single click. Our professionally
designed layouts are built to impress—and they’re just as intuitive.

[Measure what matters]

### Measure what matters

Businesses care about revenue and ROI. We evaluate dozens of key performance points and present them
in clear, simple, and actionable terms anyone can easily understand.

[Insights that matter]

### Insights that matter

Businesses care about revenue and ROI, not website bells and whistles. My Web Audit measures dozens
of valuable points and presents them in a way that anyone can understand.

[Crafted to convert]

### Crafted to convert

Audit recommendations appear in easy-to-understand terms that effectively connect with leads, show
the value of your services, and speed up sales.

[Easily brandable]

### Easily brandable

From system emails to CTAs, from logos to countdown timers—we’ve thought of it all. Make My Web
Audit truly yours with just a few simple changes.

## 4x your leads with customized audit widgets

Embed a free audit tool and see 4 times more leads than with a general PDF lead magnet. Easy to set
up, looks great on any device, and suitable for generating leads with cold email,
paid ads, SEO, and cold or warm outreach.

our flagship software platform, NexusXplore, and tool-agnostic training, OSINT Combine equips

Intelligence, communications, and operations. Each informed by the same compounding context.

that most communications teams operate on.

### Narrative Intelligence

Shadow processes the information landscape at a volume and speed no team can match: 200,000+
sources, continuously, oriented around what's forming and what to act on next. Every signal is
connected to every other signal through the narrative graph, so the read is relational, not just
factual.

* Media scanning and full-text extraction. 100K+ articles processed daily. 80% full-text access
  including paywalled content. 100% headline and metadata coverage.
* Forward-looking narrative tracking. Which stories are forming. Which are accelerating. Where your
  category narrative is heading, not just where it's been. Sentiment, velocity, and competitive
  framing tracked continuously.

  Positioning shifts, product launches, coverage patterns surfaced as they happen.
* AI visibility auditing. Citation coverage across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok.
  Share of voice by prompt. Content gap identification with recommended actions.

### Communications

Pitching, content, outreach, strategy, and campaign execution. Shadow is governed by your process,
collaborates with your team, and operates as an extension of your team.

More
* Earned media. Media list building, pitch development, journalist outreach, coverage tracking,
  press inbound triage.
* Content. Social, long-form, GEO resource pages, bylines, op-eds. Written in your voice through
  brand and executive voice cloning.
* Strategy. Narrative frameworks, messaging architecture, campaign planning, competitive
  positioning, trendjacking.
* Awards and events. Award submissions, event strategy, speaker prep, speaking placement.

### Operations

The work that keeps the business running but consumes senior time without producing client-facing
value. Shadow handles the operational overhead so your team can focus on the strategic and creative
work.

More
* New business and pipeline. Inbound management, prospect intelligence dossiers, proposal
  development, pitch decks, pipeline tracking.
* Staffing. Team recommendations, capacity allocation, staffing briefs for proposals.
* Client management. Client records, engagement tracking, workspace organization, reporting.

## A new operating model.

Your team's role moves from producing to governing: setting strategy, reviewing output, making the
decisions that require human judgment. Scale becomes a function of compounding context, not
headcount.

[Documents drafted by Shadow — a monthly strategic brief, a prospect intelligence dossier, a press
release, a communications proposal, and a master narrative — each open for review.]

Interactive document editing and review

[A client workspace in Shadow, listing drafted work products — a social listening plan, media list,
master messaging, and daily media digest — with the files they draw on.]

Client workspaces and program management

[The pipeline dashboard in Shadow — inbound, prospects, and proposals in one view.]

AI-managed pipeline and CRM

[Shadow's integrations surface, connecting into the tools the team already runs on.]

Integrated context from over 180 tools

[Pipeline analytics in Shadow — new business tracked and measured.]

Pipeline analytics and work tracking

## Powering leading teams.

[See all case studies↗][10]
[Outcast]

### Absorbed 3x inbound volume. No new headcount.

Shadow has been powering Outcast's new business operations and strategic comms practice for over a
year. Over 250 clients are managed by 40+ team members each day on Shadow. We built an autonomous
new business engine that handles inbound triage, prospect intelligence, and branded proposals —
saving hundreds of hours each month, closing new deals 50% faster, and increasing services capacity
without hiring.

[Read case study→][11]
[Haymaker]

### Awards and events production, halved in 30 days.

Haymaker was spending weeks per cycle on awards research, roadmaps, briefs, and final submissions
across their client roster. Shadow automated the full lifecycle, halving production time and saving
40+ hours per week. The engagement has since expanded into AI visibility auditing, interactive
dashboards, media monitoring, and operations infrastructure.

[Read case study→][12]
[Inworld AI]

### A full launch playbook, built from scratch in days.

Inworld needed a data-driven launch plan for voice AI models with no precedent in the market. Shadow
analyzed thousands of articles across hundreds of journalists, compounded it with keyword data to
land positioning on beat for media and buyers, and built a 300+ journalist media list with
personalized pitches.

[Read case study→][13]
[RedStudio]

### Always-on intel for 7 clients. 15 hours saved per week.

RedStudio is a 7-person lifestyle PR agency managing high-profile clients across healthcare,
biotech, and advocacy. Shadow deployed a complete communications operating system in 20 days across
the full client roster. Daily intelligence runs at 6:50 AM before anyone logs in, Forbes bylines are
voice-cloned to the client's exact diction, and every output passes a two-gate approval chain. The
team governs the system; Shadow does the production.

[Read case study→][14]

Get started with a 7-day free trial. We'll have Shadow run one of your workflows autonomously for a
week, so you can get a feel for how it works.

that most communications teams operate on.

sources, continuously, oriented around what's forming and what to act on next. Every signal is
connected to every other signal through the narrative graph, so the read is relational, not just
factual.

  including paywalled content. 100% headline and metadata coverage.

  category narrative is heading, not just where it's been. Sentiment, velocity, and competitive
  framing tracked continuously.

### Communications

collaborates with your team, and operates as an extension of your team.

More

  brand and executive voice cloning.
* Strategy. Narrative frameworks, messaging architecture, campaign planning, competitive
  positioning, trendjacking.
* Awards and events. Award submissions, event strategy, speaker prep, speaking placement.

### Operations

The work that keeps the business running but consumes senior time without producing client-facing
value. Shadow handles the operational overhead so your team can focus on the strategic and creative
work.

More
* New business and pipeline. Inbound management, prospect intelligence dossiers, proposal
  development, pitch decks, pipeline tracking.
* Staffing. Team recommendations, capacity allocation, staffing briefs for proposals.
* Client management. Client records, engagement tracking, workspace organization, reporting.

Your team's role moves from producing to governing: setting strategy, reviewing output, making the
decisions that require human judgment. Scale becomes a function of compounding context, not
headcount.

## TBR Insight Center™

TBR’s Insight Center™ is a digital-first platform that allows you to curate qualitative and
quantitative insights and collaborate with colleagues in one intuitive platform. Insight Center
contains objective data and intelligence on hundreds of companies, including telecom operators,
cloud providers, systems integrators and management consultancies.
 

Over $3 trillion in proprietary data detailing business-unit levels of revenue, expense, headcount
and margin data is accessible through the powerful visual tools native to Insight Center™.
Additionally, you can compose, configure and curate 100% of TBR’s competitive and market
intelligence research to meet your firm’s needs.
 

[Start Your Free Trial Today][37]

> TBR is the most technologically advanced partner we work with; Insight Center is a game-changer
> for partnership management and sales support.

**Senior Director Telecom Business Group**Top 3 Global OEM

> One of the biggest tech firms told us we don’t understand its business and they don’t want to
> spend time with our relationship managers. We don’t work with all of its business, so the TBR
> benchmarks and landscapes are essential to understanding how the lines of business we work with
> are doing against the rest of the market. Knowing this allows our teams to bring value to the
> table.

**Analyst Relations Director**Top 3 Silicon Chip Vendor

> With many people who work with our Global System Integrator partners, they won’t read detailed
> financials, but they need to understand what the priorities and strategies are of the GSIs, what’s
> important to our GSI partners. TBR’s quarterly coverage of the GSIs allows our Alliance Marketing
> team to continuously deliver insights that our sales teams use to improve relationships and
> achieve revenue quotas.

**Vice President Alliance Marketing**

> The quality of our Quarterly Business Reviews were all over the map. Some people spent way too
> much time understanding a customer’s financials while others were winging it. Now that TBR
> delivers the heavy lifting for updating QBR information, my team spends more time on what it means
> for us and what they are going to do next quarter.

**Vice President Global Accounts**Top 3 Data Center Colocation Provider

> TBR’s company-centric analysis is the foundation for our entire CI program. Our KLUE instance
> holds all of TBR’s intelligence, which supports tens of thousands of direct sales-makers and
> hundreds of channel partners.

**Competitive Intelligence Senior Director**Top 3 Global OEM

> Working with TBR analysts gives me and my marketing team a clear picture of how the market sees us
> and how our partners and competitors are perceived by other IT services firms. Your reputation for
> objectivity and independence is unique and very valuable.

**Vice President Analyst Relations**Global Value-added Reseller

> What sets TBR apart from other companies we work with is their responsiveness. They are the first
> to respond to an inquiry and are always available to answer deeper questions. We can’t get that
> level of service anywhere else.

**Head of Market Intelligence**Global Telecom Company

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].
* ###### Does this work for all websites?
  
  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].
* ###### Can I customize my Zigpoll?
  
  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].

  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].

  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.
